claim_text: Conventional NK -> adaptive NKG2C+ NK, HCMV-driven

audit.primary_source_citation: Gumá M, Angulo A, Vilches C, Gómez-Lozano N, Malats N, López-Botet M. 2004. Blood 104:3664-3671 — FOUNDING primary source of the HCMV/NKG2C association (not a lineage study). Gumá M, Budt M, Sáez A, Brckalo T, Hengel H, Angulo A, López-Botet M. 2006. Blood 107:3624-3631 — first in vitro "outgrowth". López-Vergès S, Milush JM, Schwartz BS, Pando MJ, ... Lanier LL. 2011. PNAS 108:14725-14732 — FIRST paper to assert the directional in vivo "becomes" ("the NKG2C+ NK cells proliferated, became NKG2Chi, and finally acquired CD57"); this is the true origin of the arrow in the claim. Rückert T, Lareau CA, Mashreghi MF, Ludwig LS, Romagnani C. 2022. Nat Immunol 23:1551-1563 — strongest/only human endogenous-barcode clonal evidence. Reviews (e.g. Lopez-Botet; O'Sullivan/Sun/Lanier Immunity 2015) were traced backwards to these four; none of the reviews cite a clonal conventional-to-adaptive tracking study, because none exists.

For the two Gumá papers I have ONLY the abstract/MeSH record (archived P1_15304389.txt, P1_16384928.txt) and have NOT substituted it for methods — the donor n for the founding 2004 paper is therefore recorded as unobtainable rather than guessed.
audit.species: human (primary claim); rhesus macaque (Truitt/Dunbar 2019 barcoding, Wu 2018 KLRC2) and mouse (Adams 2019 Ly49H transfer) used only for the clonal/transfer arms and for counter-evidence
audit.what_was_measured: In humans, cross-sectionally: the percentage of NKG2C+ cells among peripheral blood lymphocytes was measured by flow cytometry in healthy adult blood donors and stratified by HCMV, EBV and HSV IgG serology and by HLA-E/KIR genotype (Gumá 2004, Blood). In humans, longitudinally in vivo: the percentage of CD57+NKG2Chi cells within total NK cells, plus Ki-67, was measured by flow cytometry in solid-organ-transplant recipients sampled repeatedly during hospitalization around the day CMV viremia was first detected by qPCR (day 0 = start of antiviral therapy) (López-Vergès 2011, PNAS). In vitro: the percentage of CD94/NKG2C+ cells among NKp46+CD3- cells was measured at day 10-21 in PBMC cocultured with HCMV-infected versus uninfected fibroblasts, +/- IL-15, +/- CD94-blocking mAb, +/- HCMV deletion mutants, with CFSE dye dilution as the proliferation readout (Gumá 2006, Blood; Rölle 2014, JCI). Clonally: mtscATAC-seq/ASAP-seq was run on ex vivo FACS-sorted CD3-CD14-CD19-CD7+ NKG2C+ and NKG2C- NK cells, with somatic mtDNA variants called as endogenous barcodes and chi-square tested against permuted clonotype-cluster assignments, at one timepoint in 4 HCMV+ and 3 HCMV- donors and again 7, 11 and 19 months later in 3 HCMV+ donors (Rückert 2022, Nat Immunol). CRITICAL: in none of these was a NKG2C-negative conventional NK cell or clone identified at t1 and re-identified as an NKG2C+ adaptive cell at t2. Every readout is a subset frequency, a receptor density, or a clonal mark scored within the already-adaptive compartment.
audit.n: Gumá 2004 (founding source): n NOT extractable — full text paywalled (403), abstract gives no donor count. López-Vergès 2011 (origin of the directional claim): 29 HCMV+ and 24 HCMV- healthy donors, plus 6 viremic and 5 non-viremic solid-organ-transplant recipients. Rückert 2022 (clonal): 4 HCMV+ and 3 HCMV- donors for mtDNA barcoding; 3 HCMV+ donors resampled at 7, 11 and 19 months. Liu 2016 (counter-evidence): 2,208 screened, 60 NKG2C-/- and 60 NKG2C+ enrolled, of which 44 HCMV+ NKG2C-/- and 47 HCMV+ NKG2C+. Della Chiesa 2014 (counter): 3 UCBT patients grafted from NKG2C-/- donors. Rölle 2014 (in vitro): 71 cocultures, 38 meeting the >=2-fold expansion criterion. Foley 2012 J Immunol (transplant): 70 donor-recipient pairs, 22 with detectable CMV. Schlums 2015: 196 healthy donors + 78 HCT patients. Truitt/Dunbar 2019 (barcoded macaques): 3 RhCMV-seronegative + 2 RhCMV-seropositive macaques, of which only 2 were both barcode-transplanted AND experimentally RhCMV-infected. Adams 2019 (mouse co-transfer): 3-5 mice per experiment, 2 independent experiments.
audit.n_unit: donors (human, the unit for every human study); animals (rhesus macaques, mice); wells/cocultures (Rölle 2014's "71" is wells, NOT donors — the paper does not state a donor count for that figure); donor-recipient pairs (Foley 2012)
audit.controls: Yes, controls were present throughout and are generally good — they are controls for the ASSOCIATION, not for the lineage arrow. Gumá 2004: HCMV-seronegative donors, with EBV and HSV serology as virus-specificity controls, and HLA-E/KIR genotype as confounder controls. Gumá 2006: uninfected fibroblast cocultures, autologous vs allogeneic fibroblasts, multiple virus strains, CD94-blocking mAb, and UL16/UL18/UL40/US2-11 deletion mutants. López-Vergès 2011: CMV- SOT recipients and CMV+ non-viremic SOT recipients as the two comparison arms. Rückert 2022: 3 HCMV- donors, 1:1 NKG2C+/NKG2C- sort-enrichment to correct for differing subset frequencies, downsampling to equal cell numbers (4,300 and 6,000 cells), permuted clonotype-cluster relationships as an explicit null, and non-activating VMAPQSLLL vs activating VMAPRTLFL peptide in the RMA-S/HLA-E stimulation. Liu 2016: 60 NKG2C-sufficient controls plus 14 NKG2C+ and 16 NKG2C-/- HCMV-seronegative donors (none of whom had expansions). No study anywhere included the control that the claim actually requires: a purified, NKG2C-depleted conventional NK population followed for acquisition of the adaptive phenotype.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: HCMV SELECTS and clonally expands a PRE-EXISTING NKG2C+ subset rather than converting conventional NKG2C- NK cells — and this alternative is supported by the claim's own best papers. (1) Rückert 2022 shows "naive" NKG2C+ NK cells are present in HCMV- donors at frequencies comparable to HCMV+ donors, distributed across CD56bright and CD56dim, and that NKG2C+ vs NKG2C- cells in HCMV- donors are transcriptionally and epigenetically near-identical apart from KLRC2 itself. The paper's own stated hypothesis is "the expansion of individual naive NKG2C+ cells with unique accessible chromatin regions" and "a selection bottleneck during recruitment, followed by clonal expansion" — i.e. the founder is already NKG2C+. (2) Rölle 2014 CFSE dye dilution: "almost the entire NKG2C+ NK cell subset proliferated"; no experiment anywhere sorts NKG2C- cells and shows NKG2C acquisition. (3) Adams 2019 co-transferred congenically marked Ly49Hlo vs Ly49Hhi NK cells into MCMV-infected Ly49H-deficient hosts and showed the memory pool is filled by avidity SELECTION of pre-existing high-avidity cells, with corroborating higher NKG2C MFI on expanded human HSCT populations. (4) Truitt/Dunbar 2019 barcoded macaques: oligoclonal CD56-CD16+ NK clones were already present before RhCMV infection, and after infection new clones appeared while pre-existing clones disappeared — clone turnover, not tracked state conversion; authors conclude "RhCMV is not the sole driver of clonal expansion and peripheral maintenance of mature NK cells." A SECOND independent alternative is two separate origins: Bozzano 2021 (JACI) differentiates circulating Lin-CD34+DNAM-1brightCXCR4+ precursors directly into CD94/NKG2C+KIR+CD57+ progeny, bypassing any mature conventional NK intermediate, and PMID 40779632 (Sci Adv 2025) describes a thymus-derived human progenitor that generates KIR+NKG2A- NK cells. A THIRD: "conventional" and "adaptive" are the two ends of the ordinary CD56dim maturation axis (NKG2A -> KIR -> CD57) that HCMV merely skews, so cross-sectional adjacency and pseudotime ordering reflect an expression continuum, not a conversion event. Note also that the only genetic test of the arrow FAILS it (see counter_evidence).
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, and it is strong. (1) Liu LL et al., Cell Rep 2016;15:1088-99, PMID 27117418 — the single most damaging paper. Of 44 HCMV+ donors carrying homozygous KLRC2/NKG2C deletion, 11 (25%) had bona fide adaptive NK expansions (low CD7/CD161/FcepsilonR1gamma, high CD57/LILRB1, self-KIR repertoire skewing, demethylated IFNG CNS1) versus 16/47 (34%) of NKG2C-sufficient HCMV+ controls, Fisher p=0.27 n.s. NKG2C — the receptor that NAMES this claim — is dispensable. This is OBS_GENETIC evidence pointing AGAINST the claim as stated. (2) Della Chiesa M et al., J Immunol 2014;192:1471-9, PMID 24442432 — 3 patients transplanted with NKG2C-/- umbilical cord blood still developed CD56dim NKG2A- KIR+ mature expansions on HCMV infection. (3) Goodier MR et al., Blood 2014;124:2213-22, PMID 25150297 — NKG2C deletion attenuates but does not abolish HCMV-driven differentiation. (4) Adams NM et al., Immunity 2019;50:1381-1390.e5, PMID 31103381 — avidity SELECTION of a pre-existing pool, in mouse by co-transfer and in human by NKG2C receptor density. (5) Rölle A et al., JCI 2014;124:5305-16, PMID 25384219 — CFSE shows the in vitro effect is proliferation of already-NKG2C+ cells. (6) Truitt L et al. (Dunbar lab), Front Immunol 2019;10:2381, PMID 31649681 — lentivirally barcoded autologous HSPC transplant in RhCMV-seronegative rhesus macaques; oligoclonal NK clones pre-date CMV. (7) Bozzano F et al., J Allergy Clin Immunol 2021;147:2343-57, PMID 33493558 — alternative progenitor origin. (8) PMID 40779632, Sci Adv 2025 — a distinct thymic progenitor generating KIR+NKG2A- NK cells. (9) Rückert T et al., Nat Immunol 2022, PMID 36289449 — the flagship paper's own data on pre-existing "naive" NKG2C+ cells in HCMV- donors.
audit.downstream_dependency: (1) ADAPT-NK — the clinical NK-cell product of adaptive single-KIR+NKG2C+ NK cells expanded ~470-fold on HLA-E-transfected K562 feeders from screened CMV-seropositive "superdonors" (Malmberg lab, Karolinska Institutet / University of Oslo, with University of Minnesota and Fate Therapeutics; Blood Adv 2022, PMC9628692). Notably its manufacturing logic ALREADY assumes selection of pre-existing adaptive cells from pre-screened superdonors ("Healthy CMV-seropositive blood donors with large pre-existing adaptive NK cell subpopulations ... denoted as 'superdonors' were included"), so the product survives this audit even though the conversion claim does not. (2) NKG2C-genotype-driven and CMV-serostatus-driven DONOR SELECTION in allogeneic HSCT — e.g. "Donor NKG2C homozygosity contributes to CMV clearance after haploidentical transplantation", JCI Insight 2022, PMID 34990406; and the CMV-seropositive-donor/reduced-AML-relapse literature descending from Foley 2012 Blood (PMID 22180440). (3) CLINICAL HEMATOPATHOLOGY: NKG2C is now used diagnostically to call clonally restricted NK populations benign rather than neoplastic — "NKG2C Improves Diagnostic Specificity of NK Cell Receptor Restriction by Identifying Nonneoplastic Adaptive NK Cell Clones", Mod Pathol 2026, PMID 41786213. This rests directly on adaptive NK cells being a normal HCMV-driven clonal expansion of the conventional NK lineage; if adaptive NK cells had a separate progenitor origin (Bozzano 2021; PMID 40779632) the diagnostic logic would need restating. (4) The Blood 2025 "Memory NKG2C+ NK cells develop from NKG2C+ transitional precursors" model and the whole "NK cells are the innate analogue of memory T cells" framing built on it.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: OVERTURNED on the classification; UPHELD on the relative ranking. Claude's call of "BEST EVIDENCE, CLOSE TO CLONAL" conflates two different things and I am changing it. (a) UPHELD: P1 does have the deepest and best-controlled evidence base of any NK lineage claim in this screen, and genuine endogenous-barcode clonal data DO exist (Rückert 2022, mtDNA variants read out by mtscATAC-seq). (b) OVERTURNED: that clonal evidence is not clonal evidence FOR THIS ARROW. Rückert's mtDNA clonotypes are scored within the already-adaptive compartment and tracked forward in time (adaptive clone at month 0 -> same adaptive clone at month 7/11/19). That is B->B persistence, not A->B conversion. The paper explicitly reports the OPPOSITE for the conventional compartment: "such an association was absent in the conventional NK cell compartment ... suggesting that mitochondrial mutations of conventional NK cells do not flag clonal expansions but might instead be present already on the progenitor level." Its own model names the founder as a "naive NKG2C+" cell — already NKG2C-positive. Answering the hint's CRITICAL question directly: NO study in any species has tracked a single conventional NKG2C-negative NK cell or clone into the adaptive NKG2C+ state. The transplant studies are population-level phenotyping — I verified via the Foley 2012 J Immunol methods that "No chimerism or genetic marking was employed" and "No clonal tracking, barcoding, or genetic marking was used" across 70 donor-recipient pairs; Schlums 2015 likewise had no clonal tracking across 196 donors and 78 HCT patients. The macaque work (PMID 31649681) is real lentiviral barcoding but the barcode tags the HSPC, so a shared barcode across conventional and NKG2C+ compartments proves common HSPC ancestry, not mature-cell conversion — and only 2 barcoded animals were experimentally CMV-infected. What actually carries the claim is therefore INF_KINETIC: López-Vergès 2011's longitudinal order-of-appearance in 6 viremic SOT recipients (proliferate -> NKG2Chi -> acquire CD57), reinforced by the macaque observation that NKG2A/NKG2C double-positive cells rise before NKG2C-single-positive cells. Two further downgrades: the 2025 Blood "transitional precursor" paper that is currently cited as resolving the origin is Monocle3 + scVelo RNA velocity, i.e. INF_TRAJECTORY under G2, and its inferred precursor (NKG2A+NKG2C+) is itself already NKG2C-positive; and the receptor naming the claim is not required at all (Liu 2016: 25% of 44 HCMV+ KLRC2-null donors have full adaptive expansions, p=0.27 vs controls). Recommended restatement of P1: "HCMV selects and clonally expands a pre-existing NKG2C+ (and NKG2C-negative, activating-KIR+) NK subset, which then matures to an NKG2Chi CD57+ FcRgamma-low adaptive state" — a claim the data do support.
audit.methods_quote: Rückert 2022, Nat Immunol (PMC9663309), Results/Methods: "Applying this method to four HCMV + and three HCMV − donors, we identified informative mtDNA mutations by high strand concordance and variance-to-mean ratio." and "we performed a longitudinal follow-up analysis of three HCMV + donors after 11, 7 and 19 months, respectively." — i.e. the only human clonal barcoding is n=4/3 donors at one timepoint plus 3 donors resampled, scoring clones already inside the adaptive compartment. Same paper, disqualifying the conventional-to-adaptive arrow: "such an association was absent in the conventional NK cell compartment ... suggesting that mitochondrial mutations of conventional NK cells do not flag clonal expansions but might instead be present already on the progenitor level." Liu 2016, Cell Rep (PMC4858565), Experimental Procedures: "2,208 random healthy blood donors were screened for NKG2C expression by flow cytometry ... 60 controls expressing NKG2C and 60 donors lacking the NKG2C gene were identified and enrolled in the study." Rölle 2014, JCI (PMC4348979), Results: "CFSE labeling of PBMCs revealed that, in infected cocultures, almost the entire NKG2C+ NK cell subset proliferated" — expansion of cells already NKG2C+. Truitt/Dunbar 2019, Front Immunol (PMC6794559), Materials and Methods: "Indian-origin RhCMV neg RMs ( n = 3) ... Peripheral blood CD34+ HSPCs were mobilized, collected via apheresis, immunoselected, and transduced with diverse barcoded lentiviral libraries ... The barcode is passed onto each daughter cell and serves as a clonal tag." — clonal tag at the HSPC level, not at the conventional-NK level.

audit.notes: HINT VERIFICATION (all named sources located; none misattributed, one ambiguity): Gumá Blood 2004 = PMID 15304389, confirmed, association only. "Gumá Blood 2006" is ambiguous in the hint — there are TWO 2006 Gumá papers: Blood 2006 (PMID 16384928, HCMV-infected fibroblast coculture) and J Infect Dis 2006 (PMID 16741880, HIV+ patients); I used the Blood one. López-Botet = senior author on both, confirmed. Foley = two 2012 papers, both located (Blood PMID 22180440; J Immunol PMID 23077239), both population-level, no chimerism. Schlums Immunity 2015 = PMID 25786176, located. Lee Immunity 2015 = PMID 25786175, located. "Liu et al." = Liu LL, Cell Rep 2016, PMID 27117418, located and it is the key COUNTER-paper. "Rolle" = Rölle A, JCI 2014, PMID 25384219, located; I SEARCHED for it and read its abstract plus a targeted PMC fetch of its CFSE result — I did NOT find any Rölle paper bearing on clonal lineage tracking, only on expansion mechanism. NKG2C-deleted individuals: located and read (Liu 2016, Della Chiesa 2014, Goodier 2014). NOT FOUND vs NOT SEARCHED, per G3: I SEARCHED for and did not find any barcoding, mtDNA, TCR-like or chimerism-based clonal readout of a conventional-to-adaptive NK transition in humans (searches 3, 9, 10, 12, 18, 19, 22, 30, 31 above) — this is a searched-and-absent result, not an unsearched one. I DID NOT separately search the Grassmann 2019 Immunity mouse Ly49H barcoding paper's full text (the lit.py query returned 0 hits and I did not retry with WebSearch); it is mouse and receptor-defined at both ends, so it would not change the human classification, but I flag it as unread. G5 compliance: every n is given with its unit; note Rölle's "71" is WELLS not donors and is labelled as such. G2 compliance: the 2025 Blood precursor paper is scVelo/Monocle3 and is filed as INF_TRAJECTORY despite its confident framing. G7: I considered and REJECTED promoting this row to OBS_TRANSFER on the strength of the HSCT/UCBT data — in HSCT the reconstituting NK cells arise de novo from donor HSPC rather than from transferred mature conventional NK cells, so the transferred "A" is a progenitor, not a conventional NK cell, and the grafts are not depleted of the naive NKG2C+ cells that Rückert shows are present in HCMV-seronegative people at normal frequency. OBS_TRANSFER is listed in evidence_types_all only because it exists in the mouse Ly49H system (Adams 2019), where it demonstrates selection rather than conversion. adv.challenge_reason: UPGRADE of the evidence-type inventory; the row's human "strongest" call is if anything WEAKER than stated. Three defects. (1) MISSED OBS_DIRECT ENTIRELY. Genuine single-cell clonal fate mapping exists in the direct animal homolog and the row lists no OBS_DIRECT at all. Flommersfeld S, ... Grassmann S. Immunity 2021;54:2288-2304, PMID 34437840 / PMC8528403 — I pulled and read the full text (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC8528403.txt). Methods: HSCs transduced with retroviral constructs encoding distinct fluorescent proteins ("retrogenic colour barcoding"), transplanted into irradiated hosts; weeks later SINGLE colour-barcoded CD27+Ly49H+ NK cells were FACS-sorted from uninfected retrogenic spleen and adoptively transferred multiplexed into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- recipients; MCMV infection; single-cell-derived clones read out at day 8 (10 to ~100,000 daughter cells per clone). Memory arm: CD45.1+ CD27+CD62L- or CD27+CD62L+ NK cells transferred into NK-cell-deficient NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA mice, harvested d8 p.i., RE-TRANSFERRED into uninfected secondary hosts, rested 20 days, reinfected, analysed d8. n = mice. That is same-clone tracking = OBS_DIRECT by the rubric. Its companion, Grassmann S et al. Immunity 2019;50:1391-1400, PMID 31103380 (retrogenic colour-barcoding + single-cell adoptive transfer; PubMed record archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_31103380.txt, ABSTRACT_ONLY, no PMC deposit, STAR Methods not obtained), is the same technique. The row's own searches_run shows it queried both and recorded "(0 hits)" for Grassmann and never followed up Flommersfeld — a found-but-unread record, not an absent literature. I located Grassmann on a reworded query. (2) MISSED THE FOUNDING OBS_TRANSFER. The row sources OBS_TRANSFER only to Adams 2019. The founding experiment is Sun JC, Beilke JN, Lanier LL. Nature 2009;457:557-561, PMID 19136945 / PMC2674434, whose methods I pulled (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC2674434.txt): Miltenyi-enriched bulk mature NK cells from congenic CD45.1 B6 mice injected i.v. into DAP12-deficient (Tyrobp-/-) CD45.2 recipients one day before 5x10^4 PFU MCMV i.p.; CFSE dilution showed only Ly49H+ cells divided; memory CD45.1+ Ly49H+ cells enriched at d40-50 and re-transferred into a second DAP12-/- host for recall; neonatal transfer with anti-Ly49H mAb 3D10 blockade. Controls: uninfected recipients, WT recipients with competing endogenous Ly49H+ cells, MCMV-delta-m157, and 1:1 and 1:5 WT:DAP12-/- mixed bone-marrow chimeras. n = mice. Congenically marked conventional NK in, memory NK out, with functional recall — a stronger OBS_TRANSFER than the one cited. (3) OBS_GENETIC IS UNSUPPORTED AS SUPPORTING EVIDENCE AND SHOULD BE STRUCK FROM evidence_types_all. The rubric defines OBS_GENETIC as "knock out gene, B fails to appear." Every genetic test the row names (Liu 2016 PMID 27117418; Della Chiesa 2014 PMID 24442432; Goodier 2014 PMID 25150297) shows B still appears. The row names no genetic-necessity experiment in which the adaptive population fails to form. It belongs entirely in counter_evidence. (Mouse OBS_GENETIC for memory-NK formation does exist — Sun JC et al. J Exp Med 2012;209:947, PMID 22493516, IL-12R/STAT4-deficient NK fail to form memory — but the row cites nothing of the kind.) WHAT I UPHELD after re-checking the primary methods myself: Lopez-Verges 2011 (PMC3169160) is flow cytometry only — I fetched the PMC methods and confirmed verbatim "No clonal tracking was employed... no mention of cell sorting, genetic marking, barcoding, chimerism"; INF_KINETIC is the correct read of it. Ruckert 2022 quotes are verbatim-accurate against the archived full text (/home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC9663309.txt lines 43, 52) — no misquotation. The Blood 2025 transitional-precursor paper is confirmed Monocle3 + scVelo dynamical RNA velocity with an NKG2A+NKG2C+ (already NKG2C-positive) inferred root, so INF_TRAJECTORY under G2 is right. NET EFFECT: the upgrade does NOT rescue the claim. The OBS_DIRECT data point the other way (see counter-evidence).
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: Depends on a scope the row never declared, and the row is inconsistent about it. STRICT HUMAN NKG2C-ACQUISITION READING ("an NKG2C-negative human conventional NK cell becomes NKG2C+ adaptive"): INF_KINETIC, and weaker than the row states — its sole source is Lopez-Verges 2011's 6 viremic SOT recipients, which fails to generalise in the largest longitudinal cohort (Ataya 2021, PMID 34470855, n=112 KTR: "the individual magnitude and kinetics of the NKG2C+ NK response was variable"). BROAD READING (the row's own, since it admits mouse Adams 2019 as OBS_TRANSFER and macaque barcoding as a clonal arm): OBS_DIRECT — Flommersfeld 2021 PMID 34437840 and Grassmann 2019 PMID 31103380, single-cell retrogenic colour-barcode fate mapping of individual steady-state Ly49H+ NK cells into memory progeny with recall, mouse. Having admitted mouse transfer data, the row cannot consistently exclude the mouse single-cell fate map, which is two classes stronger. Full corrected list: OBS_DIRECT (mouse homolog only), OBS_TRANSFER (mouse: Sun 2009, Adams 2019), INF_KINETIC (human: Lopez-Verges 2011, Bjorkstrom 2011), INF_MARKER, INF_INVITRO, INF_TRAJECTORY. adv.new_counter_evidence: THREE the row missed, all located AND read. (1) STRONGEST NEW FIND — Bjorkstrom NK, Lindgren T, Stoltz M, ... Ljunggren H-G. J Exp Med 2011;208:13-21, PMID 21173105 / PMC3023129 (full text pulled, archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC3023129.txt). Methods: 16 patients with PCR/serology-verified acute hantavirus infection, prospective sampling weekly for 3 weeks from day 3-5 after symptom onset plus later follow-up, versus 35 age- and sex-matched uninfected blood donors; flow cytometry, KIR/HLA genotyping. n = 16 patients + 35 donors (unit: donors/patients). Two results that the row's own framing cannot absorb. (a) The authors EXPLICITLY TESTED AND REJECTED THE CONVERSION MECHANISM: "This observation could not be explained by cytokine-induced up-regulation of NKG2C expression on NKG2C- cells (unpublished data)." (b) PRE-EXISTING POOL SIZE GATES THE RESPONSE: the CMV-IgG-negative patients "had lower absolute numbers of NKG2C+ NK cells than the majority of patients being CMV IgG positive at day 5, and no subsequent expansion occurred in the IgG-negative patients." Patients without a pre-existing NKG2C+ pool never generated one, despite an identical acute viral insult. This is a published human counter-example to conversion, in a paper sitting in Lopez-Verges 2011's own reference list. It also stresses the "driven by HCMV" half of P1, since the expansion occurred in acute hantavirus infection with no evidence of CMV reactivation ("we have no evidence supporting the possibility that the increase in NKG2C+ NK cells could be a result of CMV reactivation"). (2) Ataya M, Redondo-Pachon D, ... Lopez-Botet M. J Immunol 2021;207:1882-1890, PMID 34470855 (PubMed record archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_34470855.txt; AAI site returned HTTP 403, so I have the abstract/MeSH record only and have NOT substituted it for methods). 112 CMV-seropositive kidney transplant recipients sampled pre-transplant and serially for >=24 months, with a cryopreserved subgroup of 49 followed to a median of 56 months. n = 112 and 49 patients. This is by far the largest longitudinal human dataset on this arrow and it comes from the founding lab, yet the row never touched it. It reports the kinetic signal as unreliable at scale — "the individual magnitude and kinetics of the NKG2C+ NK response was variable and only exceptionally detected among viremia(-) KTR" — and "NKG2C+ expansions were independent of KLRC2 zygosity", which directly conflicts with the gene-dose logic underpinning NKG2C-genotype donor selection (JCI Insight 2022, PMID 34990406). It is a failed-generalisation result for the n=6 SOT kinetics that the row says carries the claim. (3) Flommersfeld 2021, PMID 34437840 — beyond its classification role above, its findings are counter-evidence: single Ly49H+ NK cells do not diversify; clones adopt one of two restricted fates; those fates map onto two lineages already separable at steady state (CD62L+CD160- cNK vs CD62L-CD160+ ILC1-like NK); sorted CD27+CD62L- cells "exclusively generated CD62L- clones"; both lineages persist phenotypically distinct through the memory phase and re-expand on rechallenge; and the paper's own section heading is "ILC1-like NK cells do not serve as precursors of CD62L+ NK cells." Its introduction states the dogma it overturns: "adaptive-like immune responses to viral infection... are still considered to originate exclusively from cNK cells." This is fate-mapped support for TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS feeding the adaptive pool. Ruckert 2022 itself endorses it: "This is consistent with findings in mice, where pre-existing NK cell subtypes were preserved after murine CMV-induced expansion." Two further verbatim selection statements in Ruckert that the row underused: "The low frequency of cells expressing NKG2C before HCMV infection is the first limitation of the original pool activated by HCMV peptides" and "Expression levels of NKG2C might also contribute to selection." I also verified every PMID the row cites (41786213, 34990406, 27117418, 31649681, 33493558, 40779632, 31103381, 25384219, 24442432, 25150297, 36289449) resolves to the paper claimed — no fabricated or misattributed citation.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings: The general process borrowed here is "a naive/conventional pool converts into a long-lived antigen-experienced memory pool by clonal expansion and differentiation." All three home fields have already had their reckoning with this arrow, and all three verdicts land against P1. T CELL — (a) The gold-standard method exists and gives the OPPOSITE answer in NK cells. Buchholz VR et al. Science 2013;340:630, PMID 23493420 (with Gerlach C et al. Science 2013;340:635, PMID 23493421) did in vivo single-cell fate mapping of naive CD8 T cells and found "striking variability of immune responses derived from individual CD8+ T cells", with single naive cells generating BOTH short-lived effector and long-lived memory progeny along a linear developmental path, and robust immunity requiring "the initial recruitment of multiple precursors." The same group (Buchholz is senior author on both Grassmann 2019 and Flommersfeld 2021) then applied that exact method to NK cells and found the opposite — fate-RESTRICTED, non-diversifying clones tracing to two pre-existing lineages. So the NK field imported the T-cell "naive -> effector -> memory linear differentiation" narrative, and when the T-cell field's own definitive assay was finally run on NK cells it did not reproduce. (b) The memory repertoire is SELECTED from a pre-existing affinity spectrum, not converted. Zehn D, Lee SY, Bevan MJ. Nature 2009;458:211, PMID 19182777: clones across a broad avidity range are all recruited, and the pool "subsequently matures in affinity owing to the more prolonged expansion of high-affinity T-cell clones." This is precisely the mechanism Adams 2019 (Ly49H avidity), Grassmann 2019 (Ly49H surface density) and Ruckert 2022 (NKG2C density) each rediscovered for NK cells — i.e. the null hypothesis P1 must exclude is a 2009 T-cell result, and P1's evidence base never excludes it. (c) VIRTUAL / ANTIGEN-INEXPERIENCED MEMORY-PHENOTYPE T CELLS are the exact structural trap. Reviewed in Virtual Memory CD8+ T Cells: Origin and Beyond, PMC9835308 (2022); primary mechanism in Sosinowski T et al. J Immunol 2013, PMID 23355737, "CD8alpha+ dendritic cell trans presentation of IL-15 to naive CD8+ T cells produces antigen-inexperienced T cells in the periphery with memory phenotype." A cell carrying the full antigen-experienced surface signature that never met the antigen. This is the direct analogue of Ruckert 2022's "naive NKG2C+" NK cells, present at comparable frequency in HCMV-seronegative and HCMV-positive donors and spanning CD56bright and CD56dim. The T-cell field's settled lesson: a memory-phenotype marker set is not evidence of an antigen-driven conversion event. ILC — Vonarbourg C, ... Diefenbach A. Immunity 2010;33:736, PMID 21093318 is the experiment the NK field has never run for NKG2C, published a full year BEFORE Lopez-Verges 2011. Using adoptive transfer of genetically tagged LTi-like cells plus Rorc genetic lineage tracing, they showed "NKR-RORgammat+ innate lymphocytes but not NK cells were direct progenitors to NKR+RORgammat+ cells in vivo" — a fate map that both identifies the true precursor AND explicitly excludes the presumed one. The broader ILC lesson is the same error mode as Guma 2006's HCMV-infected fibroblast cocultures: cytokine-driven "plasticity" between marker-defined ILC states in vitro repeatedly failed to predict in vivo ontogeny until fate mapping and parabiosis adjudicated. MYELOID — this is the fatal collision. (a) Monocyte -> tissue macrophage is the canonical overturned "A becomes B", held as dogma for roughly forty years on exactly the evidence classes carrying P1: marker overlap, kinetics, and bulk transfer. Hashimoto D et al. Immunity 2013;38:792, PMID 23601688 states it outright — "Despite accumulating evidence suggesting local self-maintenance of tissue macrophages in the steady state, the dogma remains that tissue macrophages derive from monocytes. Using parabiosis and fate-mapping approaches, we confirmed that monocytes do not show significant contribution to tissue macrophages" — and Yona S et al. Immunity 2013;38:79, PMID 23273845 (CX3CR1-CreER fate mapping) showed the resident populations "are established prior to birth and maintain themselves subsequently during adulthood independent of replenishment by blood monocytes." A PRE-EXISTING, SELF-MAINTAINING POPULATION was mistaken for a conversion product for four decades. Critically, the same Yona paper validated a REAL conversion in the same system (Ly6C+ -> Ly6C- monocytes), proving the method discriminates true arrows from false ones — so its absence in the NK field is a gap, not an impossibility. (b) Innate immune memory is written at the PROGENITOR level, not by converting a mature cell. Kaufmann E et al. Cell 2018;172:176, PMID 29328912: BCG reprograms HSCs and MPPs, and "BCG-educated HSCs generate epigenetically modified macrophages", with parabiosis, chimeric mice and adoptive transfer showing the training is sustained through the stem-cell compartment. Map that onto P1 and it is directly fatal: Ruckert 2022's own negative control says mtDNA clonal marks in the conventional NK compartment "do not flag clonal expansions but might instead be present already on the progenitor level", and HCMV establishes latency in CD34+ HSPCs. A progenitor-level HCMV imprint reproduces EVERY observation in P1's evidence base — elevated NKG2C+ frequency, clonal marks, adaptive epigenetic remodelling, transplant-associated expansions — without any mature conventional NK cell ever converting. No study in P1's evidence base excludes it, and the human HSCT/UCBT data the row correctly declined to promote to OBS_TRANSFER are exactly the data that would be confounded by it. This progenitor-level alternative is invisible to NK keywords and is the single largest unexamined hole in the row.

adv.load_bearing_reason: HIGH survives, but I reallocate the weight because the row's headline dependency is not actually load-bearing. STRUCK — ADAPT-NK (Blood Adv 2022, PMC9628692) does NOT depend on the arrow. By the row's own quoted manufacturing logic it screens CMV-seropositive "superdonors" with large PRE-EXISTING adaptive subsets and expands them on HLA-E-transfected K562 feeders; the product is agnostic between conversion and selection and is unaffected if the arrow fails. Listing it first is generous. GENUINELY LOAD-BEARING, and I verified it: Wilk AJ, Gitana G, Oak J. "NKG2C Improves Diagnostic Specificity of Natural Killer (NK) Cell Receptor Restriction by Identifying Nonneoplastic Adaptive NK Cell Clones." Mod Pathol 2026;39(5):100984, PMID 41786213 (Stanford Pathology; record archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_41786213.txt). Their stated logic: KIR-restricted "NK clones of uncertain significance" are reclassified as reactive, and — decisively — "several cases that meet diagnostic criteria for NK-large granular lymphocytic leukemia" are called NONNEOPLASTIC on the strength of NKG2C positivity plus CMV viremia. A patient is spared a leukaemia diagnosis on the premise that a clonally restricted NKG2C+ NK population is a normal HCMV-driven expansion arising within the ordinary NK lineage. That is a concrete, named, clinical dependency with direct patient consequence. Note how it interacts with my audit: it SURVIVES the "selection not conversion" restatement, because a selected and expanded pre-existing clone is still non-neoplastic — but it does NOT survive the separate-progenitor models the row correctly flagged (Bozzano 2021 PMID 33493558; Sci Adv 2025 PMID 40779632), nor a progenitor-level HCMV-imprint model of the kind established for trained immunity (Kaufmann 2018 PMID 29328912), under which an "adaptive" NK clone would be a progenitor-derived clonal population and the benign/neoplastic boundary would need restating. SECOND REAL DEPENDENCY, now under active conflict: NKG2C-genotype-driven donor selection in haploidentical HSCT — "Donor NKG2C homozygosity contributes to CMV clearance after haploidentical transplantation", JCI Insight 2022, PMID 34990406 (verified). This rests on KLRC2 gene dose driving the adaptive response, and my new find directly contradicts it: Ataya 2021 (PMID 34470855) reports across 112 CMV+ kidney transplant recipients that "NKG2C+ expansions were independent of KLRC2 zygosity", compounding Liu 2016 (PMID 27117418), where 25% of 44 HCMV+ KLRC2-null donors had full adaptive expansions (p=0.27 vs controls). A clinical donor-selection practice therefore rests on a receptor that two independent human cohorts report as dispensable. That unresolved conflict is itself an argument for HIGH, not for a downgrade.
adv.better_primary_source: PARTIAL — the row's FOUNDING source is right, its ORIGIN-OF-THE-ARROW source is not the earliest. Guma 2004 Blood, PMID 15304389, is correctly identified as the founding association paper. But the row names Lopez-Verges 2011 PNAS (PMID 21825173) as "the FIRST paper to assert the directional in vivo 'becomes'", and an earlier longitudinal in vivo human primary source exists: Bjorkstrom NK, Lindgren T, Stoltz M, Fauriat C, Braun M, Evander M, Michaelsson J, Malmberg K-J, Klingstrom J, Ahlm C, Ljunggren H-G. "Rapid expansion and long-term persistence of elevated NK cell numbers in humans infected with hantavirus." J Exp Med 2011;208(1):13-21, PMID 21173105, PMC3023129, DOI 10.1084/jem.20100762 — published 17 January 2011, roughly eight months before Lopez-Verges (6 September 2011), and cited in Lopez-Verges's own reference list. It is a prospective longitudinal in vivo human study (16 acute hantavirus patients, weekly sampling from day 3-5 through week 3 plus later follow-up, 35 age/sex-matched uninfected controls) establishing in vivo expansion and long-term persistence of NKG2C+ CD57+ NK cells in humans. It is the earlier INF_KINETIC primary source and should replace or precede Lopez-Verges in that slot. It also matters because it cuts against the claim it is being used to found: the authors report that they tested and excluded NKG2C acquisition by NKG2C-negative cells, and that patients lacking a pre-existing NKG2C+ pool at day 5 mounted no expansion at all. Full text obtained and archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC3023129.txt.
